newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell at the start of trade on Tuesday, depressed by Nikkei 225 futures in Chicago which closed lower overnight than in Osaka, brokers said.
They added that Tuesday was the last trading day for February delivery and buying interest could be limited.
As of 0016 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was down 116.69 points, or 0.62 percent at 18,780.30. Its March futures were up 10 points at 18,870.
"Buying back of the bank sector is gradually easing and the market is wondering when the profit-taking phase for high-technology shares will end," a "Big Four" trader said.
